node.date_label: L’Histoire en miettes (1987) · La marche des idées (2003) · Le pari biographique (2005) · “L’histoire entre la guerre des mémoires et la Justice” (2017)
node.description: A historian of historiography, intellectual life and biography. His retrospective account of L’Histoire en miettes presents its critique of histories that foreground permanence at the expense of events, subjects and change; he also states that his own earlier theoretical position changed. In a later primary article he distinguishes historical explanation, public remembrance and judicial judgment. The entry treats those distinctions as his methodological intervention, while keeping his descriptions of law and legal institutions within their historical publication context.

incident_edges.relationship: Distinguishes work of memory, historical explanation and judicial judgment while examining their overlapping claims on the past.
incident_edges.evidence_note: Own article abstract and printed pp. 67–69 read. The argument distinguishes evidentiary inquiry and revisable historical interpretation from judicial closure; legal examples are neither current guidance nor independently certified.

named_group_routes.relationship: Using Braudel’s remarks as reported by Dosse, Prost criticizes the marginal place that determinist social history leaves for human agency.
named_group_routes.evidence_note: Specifically attributed criticism of the determinist rhetoric quoted in this passage, not a general rejection of Braudel. Prost explicitly says the problem extends beyond Labrousse and Marxist historians. Dosse is the named mediator; Braudel’s underlying statements and Dosse’s complete work were not freshly read. Prost’s separate use of Braudel’s warning about retrospective hindsight does not erase this objection. Selected authorial passage in the expanded digital edition, identified by EPUB ISBN 9782757843765 (BAnQ catalog: April 2014). Read through a public third-party transcription, not a collated print facsimile. No claim that the exact wording was present in 1996; complete book and cited originals unread.
